paper_title: Do direct detection experiments constrain axionlike particles coupled to electrons?
suggested_experiment_name: X-ray and gamma-ray astronomy limits on ALP decay (NuSTAR/XMM-Newton/INTEGRAL)
notes: This is a reinterpretation/theory paper arguing that ALPs coupled to electrons in the keV-MeV range decay radiatively and cannot be dark matter, thus invalidating existing direct detection limits (GERDA, EDELWEISS-III, SuperCDMS, Majorana). It does not present a new numerical exclusion curve in tabular form; the figure shows recasts of existing experimental limits and lifetime/astrophysical exclusion regions, but no extractable tabulated data points are provided in the text.
